claims.value: 380 RAW files (19 tissue×sex groups × 20 SDS-PAGE slices)
claims.evidence: PRIDE files/all: 399 files including 380 .RAW and 19 .msf search results. Filenames SEX_TISSUE_N.RAW.
PRIDE organisms and PLoS One rhesus monkey tissue proteome.

claims.value: 12 organs across male/female panels (19 sex×tissue combinations)
claims.evidence: Methods: male 6.54y nine tissues (frontal cortex, cerebellum, right ventricle, MSLN, PBD, liver, pancreas, prostate apex, penis); female 10.55y ten tissues (+ breast, ovary, clitoris; no prostate/penis). Filename keys MSLN=mesenteric lymph node, PBD=proximal bile duct (mapped to UBERON bile duct), VENTRICLE=heart right ventricle, PROSTATE_MID=prostate gland, BREAST2=breast, LIVER4=liver.
Methods explicitly state ages of the single male and female subjects; both adult animals.
No disease model; tissues from TNPRC animals euthanized for colony management reasons.
Each gel lane excised into twenty slices; trailing integer in RAW filename is slice number.
PRIDE instrument LTQ; Methods LTQ-XL data-dependent MS/MS of top 8 ions. CID is the LTQ fragmentation mode (not separately named in Methods).

claims.value: Trypsin; Oxidation M variable only; 2.0 Da / 1.0 Da
claims.evidence: PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol SEQUEST parameters; Carbamidomethyl not searched/stated for LTQ-XL tissue dataset despite iodoacetamide listed among reagents.
Single non-human vertebrate organism; DDA shotgun gel-LC-MS/MS.

limitations: Paper text says prostate (apex) while RAW filenames use PROSTATE_MID; mapped to prostate gland without asserting apex vs mid subdivision.
PBD mapped to general UBERON bile duct (no exact 'proximal bile duct' term).
CID dissociation inferred from LTQ-XL DDA platform; Methods do not spell out 'CID'.
Orbitrap-XL comparative runs mentioned in paper are not the deposited PXD001972 RAW set (LTQ-XL only).
